newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria, Tunisia sign trade agreements.
newsitem.headline: Syria, Tunisia sign trade agreements.

text.p: Syria and Tunisia signed trade deals on Tuesday to boost bilateral trade between the two countries, official sources said.

They said Syrian Economy Minister Mohammad Imadi and Tunisian Trade Minister Mondher Zenaidi signed the agreements which set out to increase trade between the two countries to be worth at least $100 million a year.

The deals allow Syrian oil to be exported to Tunisia in return for Tunisian animal feeds. A similar exchange of goods would include Syrian foodstuffs and industrial products for Tunisian cement and car tyres.
Sources also said the two sides would work to stop the double taxation between the two countries by the end of 1996.
